description: Fix ModelSelect popover item click swallowed by Base UI Popover dismissable layer

tasks.title: Fix ModelSelect popover mouse-click model selection
tasks.description: Fix the ModelSelect component so real mouse clicks on model options inside the Base UI Popover trigger onChange. Attach a native pointerdown listener with event delegation on the popover list container, intercepting clicks before Base UI's document-level dismiss handler fires. Add data-model-id attributes to option buttons for delegation. Retain existing onClick handler as fallback. Add test coverage for mouse-click selection via fireEvent.pointerDown. Verify existing ModelSelect and SettingsPage tests pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Real mouse click on a model option inside the popover calls onChange with the selected model ID
After mouse-click selection, the popover closes and the trigger displays the selected model name and full ID
Keyboard Enter selection on a highlighted model option still works via the search input's onKeyDown
Search input filtering still filters the model list correctly
X clear button (allowClear) still clears the selection and calls onClear
Existing ModelSelect.test.tsx tests pass without modification
New test in ModelSelect.test.tsx verifies mouse-click (pointerdown) triggers onChange
tasks.notes: Implementation approach per design.md: add useRef+useEffect with native pointerdown listener on the scrollable list container div, use closest('[data-model-id]') for event delegation, call e.stopPropagation() then selectModel(modelId). Add data-model-id={model.id} to each option Button. Keep existing onClick handler.
